candidates.change_summary: Remove the require revert when already initialized, allowing MinSum to be changed after initialization.
Change assignment target from state variable to a local variable so MinSum is not updated.
Replace the assigned value with a constant zero so MinSum becomes 0 after call.

Remove the nonReentrant modifier body by deleting the require check and locking logic, allowing reentrant calls that could change MinSum behavior indirectly (but here it directly affects SetMinSum by removing revert path).
Remove the revert check so SetMinSum can be called multiple times.
Remove nonReentrant_ modifier body so SetMinSum reentrancy lock is never engaged.
Replace MinSum assignment with a no-op so SetMinSum never changes the state variable.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from SetLogFile, changing the observable behavior of the SetLogFile function by allowing it to be called without reentrancy protection.
Remove the require(!locked_) check in the nonReentrant_ modifier, allowing reentrant calls to functions using this modifier.
Replace 'intitalized = true;' with 'intitalized = false;' so that Initialized() sets the variable to false instead of true.
Delete the statement 'intitalized = true;' so that Initialized() does not change the state variable.
Remove the nonReentrant modifier from Initialized() by dropping 'nonReentrant_' from the function signature.
Replace 'locked_ = false;' with 'locked_ = true;' so the modifier leaves locked_ permanently true, preventing Initialized() from executing after first reentrant call.
Delete 'locked_ = false;' so locked_ stays true after modifier execution, causing Initialized() to revert on second call.

Delete the require check 'require(!locked_);' so the modifier never blocks reentrant calls, but that doesn't change Initialized behavior directly; however, deleting 'require(!locked_);' won't alter intitalized value. (SKIP — no change to intitalized). This is not emitted.
